s='CCOC(=O)C1=C(N)OC2=C(C(=O)CCC2)C1C1=CC=CS1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print('SMILES valid:', m is not None)
try:
 import selfies
 x=selfies.encoder(s)
 print('SELFIES:', x)
 print('Round-trip:', Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(selfies.decoder(x)), canonical=True)==Chem.MolToSmiles(m, canonical=True))
except Exception as e:
 print(type(e).__name__, str(e))
